title: 字符串长度与 Unicode
description: 用相同的 cat、😀（U+1F600）和 e + U+0301 比较 UTF-16 码元、Unicode 码点与 UTF-8 字节。按这个顺序，文档推导的计数分别为 3/3/3、2/1/4、2/2/3；这不是执行结果，也不是字素簇数或屏幕宽度。
scopeNote: 已核查的子集：JavaScript、TypeScript、Python、Go，共四门语言、三套运行时语义。仅核查所列章节，不代表完整手册覆盖；未收录不代表不支持。所有示例未执行。

entries.summary: length 统计 UTF-16 码元；展开字符串后统计码点；Buffer.byteLength 指定 UTF-8 后统计字节。三个值衡量不同单位。
entries.versionNotes: 保存为 .mjs；Buffer 是 Node API，不是浏览器标准 API。样本均为有效 Unicode 文本，未做正规化；码点数不是字素簇数或显示宽度。本例不验证孤立代理项或其他无效输入。示例未执行。

entries.baseline: Python 3.14；内置 str 与标准编码器
entries.summary: len(str) 统计码点；编码为 UTF-8 后用 len 统计字节。为对照 JavaScript，把文本编码为无 BOM 的 UTF-16-LE，再将字节数除以 2 得到码元数。
entries.versionNotes: UTF-16-LE 明确字节序且不添加 BOM；不要直接换成会添加 BOM 的 utf-16。此计数不代表 Python 内部内存占用。仅处理本例有效 Unicode 文本，不做正规化或字素簇分割；默认 strict 编码可能拒绝代理码点。示例未执行。

en.baseline: Python 3.14; built-in str and standard codecs
en.summary: len(str) counts code points; len after UTF-8 encoding counts bytes. For comparison with JavaScript, encode as BOM-free UTF-16-LE and divide the byte count by two to count code units.
en.versionNotes: UTF-16-LE fixes byte order without adding a BOM; do not substitute utf-16, which adds a BOM. This does not measure Python object memory. Only the valid Unicode samples are covered, without normalization or grapheme segmentation; strict encoding can reject surrogate code points. Example not executed.

entries.baseline: Go 1.23.0；标准库 unicode/utf8 与 unicode/utf16
entries.summary: len(string) 统计字节；对有效 UTF-8 文本，utf8.RuneCountInString 统计码点。先转换为 []rune 再用 utf16.Encode，得到可与 JavaScript 对照的 UTF-16 码元数。
entries.versionNotes: Go string 可以包含任意字节，不保证有效 UTF-8；RuneCountInString 将无效或截断编码的每个错误字节计为一个 rune，因此它不是有效性检查。本例只含有效 UTF-8，不做正规化，不统计字素簇或显示宽度。Go 1.23.0 是固定示例基线，不宣称为最新版。示例未经编译或执行。

en.summary: len(string) counts bytes; utf8.RuneCountInString counts code points in valid UTF-8. Convert to []rune and then use utf16.Encode to count UTF-16 code units for comparison with JavaScript.
en.versionNotes: A Go string may contain arbitrary bytes, not necessarily valid UTF-8. RuneCountInString counts each erroneous byte in invalid or truncated encodings as a rune, so it is not a validity check. Samples are valid UTF-8, without normalization, grapheme segmentation, or display-width measurement. Go 1.23.0 is a pinned illustrative baseline, not a claim of latest release. Example not compiled or executed.

en.title: String length and Unicode
en.description: Compare UTF-16 code units, Unicode code points, and UTF-8 bytes for the same cat, 😀 (U+1F600), and e + U+0301 samples. In that order, the documentation-derived counts are 3/3/3, 2/1/4, and 2/2/3. These are not execution results, grapheme-cluster counts, or screen widths.
en.scopeNote: Reviewed subset: JavaScript, TypeScript, Python, and Go, covering four languages and three runtime contracts. Only listed sections were reviewed, not complete manuals. Missing coverage does not mean unsupported. All examples are unexecuted.
